turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My budget for a laptop is about six hundred dollars. Is that realistic?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Definitely. You can get a solid everyday laptop for that, especially on sale.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, wait, what should I avoid at that price?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Avoid anything with only four gigs of memory or a spinning hard drive. Those feel slow very quickly.

turns.text: What about refurbished ones? My friend

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: They can be a great deal if they come from the manufacturer with a warranty. You often get a better model for the same money.

turns.speaker: moshi
